g.text: Passing tests, and scores on 21 cross-checks
Top: passing tests in the earlier engine's suite, Sep 2025 to Aug 2026.
Bottom: 21 cross-checks (12 refereed by SWI-Prolog) replayed on saved versions of the earlier engine (blue) and the rewrite (orange).
Steps show the last logged count per day, so most mid-refactor dips are hidden (the worst logged: 149 passing, Sep 9, 2025). Runner settings
changed several times, so small zigzags aren't meaningful. The cross-checks were written in Sep 2026; versions before May 2026 couldn't
be replayed; two of the rewrite's passes are test-runner timeouts. Data and method: evidence/README.md.
